slides.headline: Bigger swings, bigger hopes.

posts.caption:

Save this for the next time someone throws finance jargon at you. 🔖

#finance #personalfinance #financialliteracy #moneybasics #learnfinance #stocks #investing

slides.headline: Value investing means buying shares for **less** than what the company is [[actually worth]].
slides.footer: You're hunting for a discount on a solid company.

slides.headline: You think a company is worth [[$70]] a share, but it's trading at [[$40]].

steps.title: You buy and wait
steps.sub: For the price to catch up

slides.closing: Buying below worth is the heart of **value investing**.

slides.headline: Patience is part of the strategy.

rows.text: A real business with real earnings, priced cheaply

slides.note: A low price alone isn't enough; the business still has to be sound.

slides.headline: Cheap isn't always a bargain.
slides.sub: Value investors compare price to what a business actually earns.
slides.note: Simplified example.
slides.label: THE GAP

slides.title: Value investing = Buy low
slides.sub: Price below worth.

posts.caption:

slides.headline: The yield curve is a line showing **interest rates** on government bonds of [[different lengths]].
slides.footer: Plotted with time on one axis, rate on the other.

slides.headline: A 2-year bond pays [[3%]]; a 30-year bond pays [[5%]].

steps.sub: That line is the yield curve

slides.closing: Normally, lending for **longer** pays a bit more.

slides.headline: A line investors watch closely.
slides.sub: What the shape usually means.

slides.headline: Short vs. long-term rates.
slides.sub: Normally, longer bonds pay a higher rate.
slides.note: Illustrative rates.
slides.label: A NORMAL CURVE

slides.title: Yield curve = Rate by term
slides.sub: Shows rates for short vs. long loans.

slides.headline: An inverted yield curve is when **short-term rates** are [[higher]] than long-term rates - the opposite of normal.
slides.footer: It has preceded many past recessions.

slides.headline: A 2-year bond pays [[5%]]; a 10-year bond pays only [[4%]].

slides.headline: A closely watched warning sign.

slides.headline: Flipped from the usual order.

slides.title: Inverted curve = Rates flip
